newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MONDAY SESSION MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MONDAY SESSION MIXED.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted steady on the key U.S. unit after Monday's interbank session which saw a fair balance between importer demand for foreign currency and export receipts.
It however registered losses on European currencies and gained on the South African rand, reflecting movements on international markets.
"We got a few inflows into the market but they seemed well-matched by the outflows because the (Zimbabwe/U.S. dollar) exchange rate didn't move much today," commented one dealer.

The local unit ended the day at 11.3150/3250 on the U.S. dollar, where it was also quoted at Friday's close, but weakened against sterling to 18.5030/5390 from 18.3740/4020 and to 6.6290/6325 from 6.5150/5240 versus the mark.
It was however quoted a touch firmer against the rand at 2.5150/5160 compared to 2.5225/5265.
